summary: Alerts from the scan of X, which runs every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Event time is when the incident happened, which can differ from when it was reported; it says not stated when sources don't give it. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.bottom: Houthi Riyadh claims, IRGC tanker and drone claims and a 2003-low US diesel stock keep risk high; Brent below $100 shows easing Iran-strike fears.

brent.detail: Brent fell below $100/bbl for the first time since Oct 7 around 11:57 pm SGT, 4 Nov; US and Brent futures down more than $4 (First Squawk, LiveSquawk)

alerts.headline: Brent crude falls below $100 for the first time since Oct 7; market prices a lower chance of a new US attack on Iran after the midterm rout.
EIA: US diesel (distillate) stocks fall below 100M bbl, lowest since 2003, after a 3.6M bbl weekly draw.
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing US EIA weekly data; also LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: IRGC says its air defences destroyed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, its 15th MQ-1 claim.
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing Iranian state media / IRGC; also CGTN, FinancialJuice

alerts.headline: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claims a ballistic missile hit Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, causing major damage; urges airlines to avoid it.
alerts.source: Yahya Saree (Houthi military spokesman, Arabic); First Squawk

alerts.headline: TankerTrackers: Iran's Hormuz authority doubled its 'non-compliant' tanker target list to 240 ships; about 30% of cargo on listed tankers is Iraqi crude.
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei says Hormuz action was a response to US 'aggression' and warns further US attacks will bring a 'far wider' response.
alerts.source: First Squawk; Iran International, Al Arabiya, Al Mayadeen

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Jazan, home to Aramco's 400,000 b/d Jazan refinery, over a possible threat; danger declared passed minutes later.
alerts.source: Open Source Intel (citing Saudi Civil Defense); Iran International

alerts.headline: Aramco CEO says work has begun to expand the East-West Pipeline that bypasses Hormuz; engineering underway on other export routes and more storage abroad (per Reuters).
Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Najran province near the Yemen border, then declares danger passed minutes later; unverified reports of explosions.
Trump tells Politico he is again open to striking Iran: 'if we see any opportunity to do one thing or another, we're going to do it'
Iran International: Iran enlists China and Russia in Hormuz talks with US; mediators weigh China guaranteeing US sanctions relief for nuclear concessions.
IRGC now says four tankers destroyed by naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and still burning; two more vessels detained.
alerts.source: FirstSquawk / RedboxWire / LiveSquawk citing IRGC (Sepah News)

alerts.headline: WSJ: Iran escalating Hormuz ship attacks with underwater drones and limpet mines; Kpler says flows last week averaged 7.8M bpd, about 45% of prewar, after 35+ October incidents.
Saudi Civil Defense issues early-warning alert for Riyadh as ballistic missiles reportedly launched from Yemen; all-clear about 10 minutes later, no damage reported.
Trump tells the FT the US has no immediate plan to strike Iran, calling the standoff 'brilliant' and saying 'we're not really in a war'.
UKMTO 195-26: tanker struck by two unknown projectiles in engine room 14 nm NE of Lima, Oman, in the southern Strait of Hormuz corridor; no casualties.
NYT: Pentagon readying options for a renewed major US attack on Iran, possibly as early as Nov 4, right after the midterms.
Houthi military source tells Tasnim that Saudi Aramco facilities are within direct firing range, a fresh threat amid Saudi-Houthi fighting.
NYT: Israel told US Iran is weighing chemical weapons use; some US officials see it as pressure to resume major combat against Iran.
Protesting Basra tribes shut Station 8 at Iraq's West Qurna 1 oil field, give government 3 days before closing all fields.
Iran's Rezaee: US response to Iran's demands not convincing; Hormuz stays closed until all seven Iranian conditions are met.
Russia says it struck a cargo ship 24 km south of Odesa, raising Black Sea shipping risk.
US reportedly approves Qatar's draft MOU for Iran; Saudi Arabia and UAE briefed and approve; both sides said to make nuclear and frozen-asset concessions.
alerts.source: First Squawk (citing sources close to mediation team)

alerts.headline: US Energy Secretary Wright says the overnight US strikes on Iran, including Qeshm Island, have not impacted oil flows.
Houthi spokesman Saree claims a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's Abha airport, halting air traffic, and a ballistic missile hit on Khamis Mushait air base; no Saudi confirmation yet.
Qatari mediators expect the US and Iran to answer a new proposal to advance talks within 36 hours, an official told Reuters.
IRGC says it shot down two US LUCAS attack drones over Bandar Khamir near Hormuz; explosions also reported near Bandar Abbas
UK union Unite says Apache's North Sea offshore workers will escalate strike action, a risk to Forties/Beryl output feeding the Brent benchmark

alerts.eventTime: Early hours of 3 Nov, Iran time (~9:00 am SGT, est.)
alerts.headline: Iran's IRGC Navy says three oil tankers that switched off tracking and used unauthorised Strait of Hormuz routes struck naval mines and are burning, abandoned on the southern shore; vessels not named, no independent confirmation

Iran's security council chief Mohsen Rezaei reportedly rejected a Qatari plan for direct contact between US diplomats and Iran's delegation in Doha; mediation by Qatar and Pakistan stays indirect, focused on reopening Hormuz
Iranian assessments reportedly see a return to war as increasingly likely, as President Pezeshkian, Speaker Qalibaf and FM Araghchi urge the military to engage with Qatar's proposal
Aramco CEO Nasser says the global refining market has lost 5 mb/d of supply and tanker attacks have eliminated 15% of effective tanker capacity; spot crude now trades above futures
Aramco CEO Nasser says Saudi output can return to pre-conflict levels within days and reach 12 mb/d max capacity in under three weeks; warns of winter pressure on energy markets
Senior Iranian official tells Reuters Iran and the US are far from a deal to end the war, saying Tehran will not accept excessive US demands
Trump tells Fox News the US may need to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site, saying it would not be a problem and could be done within an hour
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, citing Trump on Fox News

alerts.headline: Kazakhstan says oil transit on the Atyrau-Samara pipeline has resumed after a drone attack halted flows on 2 Nov, restoring Kazakh crude flows into Russia's Transneft system
India confirms Indian dhow MSV Al Jusufi was struck by an unidentified aerial object off Oman's coast on 2 Nov; one of 14 Indian crew killed, 13 rescued by Oman's coast guard
alerts.source: India's Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal, via ANI

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones reportedly struck Russia's Yaroslavl oil refinery, setting off a fire in the industrial zone, as part of the large overnight drone raid on western Russia
alerts.source: Several OSINT accounts incl. Exilenova+, WW3 Monitor and Russian-language channels (translated)

alerts.headline: WSJ: CENTCOM has been laying the groundwork for wider strikes on Iran, moving more missile defenses and munitions into the region, and Washington has told Gulf states to prepare for a short, focused operation shortly after the US midterm elections
alerts.source: Wall Street Journal via Post Open Source

alerts.eventTime: 9:00 am, 3 Nov (est., raid ongoing at time of post)
alerts.headline: OSINTtechnical says a large Ukrainian drone raid is under way deep into western Russia, with local reports of hundreds of drones heading for targets, after four straight nights of hits on Russian oil sites

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Brent crude fell below $100 a barrel for the first time since October 7 as markets priced a lower chance of a new US attack on Iran.
That follows a tense Wednesday of IRGC tanker-mine and drone claims, a Houthi strike claim on Riyadh's airport, and US diesel stocks at their lowest since 2003.
